newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: No movement so far on stability pact-EU diplomat.
newsitem.headline: No movement so far on stability pact-EU diplomat.

text.p: EU countries repeated their known positions on a post-EMU stability pact during initial discussions at a special meeting of European Union finances ministers on Thursday, an EU diplomat said.
"There has been no change," the diplomat told Reuters.

EU finance ministers were meeting in Dublin on Thursday night to try to resolve their differences on the precise terms of the pact, aimed at ensuring fiscal discipline after the EU launches its planned single currency in 1999.

The diplomat said positions were the same as they were at the end of a finance ministers' meeting in Brussels last week, which came close to agreeing but was stuck on the definition of when a country could be exempted from penalties for running a budget deficit of more than three percent.
Germany was holding out for tougher terms than its EU partners wanted.
